== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The levitation ring is a magical device worn on the finger that provides the user with telekinetic abilities and flight. It functions by generating an invisible cushion or bubble of force, which can be used to hover, drift through the air, or land safely from significant heights. Beyond simple movement, the ring can be used for more complex telekinetic tasks, such as manipulating objects, pushing enemies away, cushioning falls, or even carrying other people and heavy items like staves or crates. While the ring is highly versatile, it operates on a limited power supply that can be depleted through heavy use. It also possesses an independent energy source, allowing it to function even when ambient [[Aether]] is scarce.}}

== The Captain ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|[[Varic Vallenar]] wears a levitation ring on his left hand, an item that allows the narrator to fly. This device is also utilized for smaller tasks, such as moving objects like water bottles, though it becomes necessary for performing more complex movements. Later, the Captain employs a levitation ring to float, and despite a hull breach, the ring remains intact.}}
